title: Contact & Message Form
description: Contact block with labelled contact channels and a validated message form (name, email, topic, message) that confirms success inline and with a toast.
useWhen: Visitors must reach the team for questions, catering or careers and a written form is expected
avoidWhen: The only requirement is to list kitchen addresses and opening hours

title: Full-Bleed Image Hero
description: Full-viewport brand hero: natural-light food photograph behind a warm cream content panel that owns the page h1, an eyebrow, a supporting paragraph, two actions and a short trust-badge row.
useWhen: A home or landing page needs its h1 plus the primary ordering action above the fold
avoidWhen: A page needs a compact text-only intro, or a hero whose headline should sit over a dark scrim

title: Kitchen Locations
description: Multi-location block for a restaurant group: one address card per kitchen with street address, phone, opening hours and a pickup action, paired with an embedded map and a pickup note.
useWhen: The brand runs several kitchens and the page must list addresses, phones and opening hours
avoidWhen: The brand has a single address that only needs a map and a phone number

title: Filterable Menu Catalog
description: Interactive menu board: category tabs, multi-select dietary filter chips, a sort control, a live result count, an empty state and dish cards grouped under a category sub-heading with photograph, description, price, calories and optional badge.
useWhen: Guests must browse every dish and narrow it down by category, diet or price
avoidWhen: Only a few hand-picked dishes need to be shown, which the Seasonal Picks block already covers

title: Menu Intro Banner
description: Compact menu page opener that owns the page h1: eyebrow, headline, supporting paragraph, a short row of service notes and one wide food photograph.
useWhen: A menu or catalogue page needs its h1 and a visual opener above the filters
avoidWhen: The page already opens with a full-viewport hero

title: Order Call To Action
description: Deep brand-green ordering band with a heading, supporting line, primary and secondary actions, and an optional dish photograph beside the copy. The single high-contrast brand moment on a page.
useWhen: A page should close a section or its content with the strongest ordering prompt
avoidWhen: The page already opens with a full ordering hero that carries the same actions

title: Seasonal Picks
description: Cards for the dishes currently peaking in season: photograph, optional status badge, dish name, one-line description and price, plus a heading action that points to the full menu.
useWhen: A page should highlight a handful of rotating, in-season dishes with prices
avoidWhen: The page needs the complete filtered list of every dish on the menu

title: Site Footer
description: Site-wide footer with the brand blurb and order action, grouped navigation, kitchen addresses, opening hours, social links, a newsletter sign-up form and legal links. Renders once from layout.footer, so its column labels stay non-heading text and only the newsletter block carries an h2.
useWhen: Every page needs shared store details, opening hours, navigation and a mailing-list sign-up
avoidWhen: A page needs a local contact or locations content block inside its own body content

title: Site Header
description: Sticky site-wide header for a restaurant brand: wordmark link, primary navigation resolved from page and external targets, a permanent Order Now action, and a mobile navigation sheet. It renders once from layout.header and owns no page h1.
useWhen: Every page needs the shared brand navigation and the ordering entry point
avoidWhen: A single page needs a local in-content navigation strip or section jump bar

title: Sourcing Story
description: Farm-to-table ingredient story: a heading with two paragraphs beside a produce or farm photograph, a sage band of farm statistics, and a grid of preparation practices with their own sub-headings.
useWhen: The brand story is about ingredient sourcing, farm partners and kitchen craft
avoidWhen: The block is really about the people behind the brand, or about a single product

title: Guest Reviews
description: Customer review grid: each card shows a star rating, a quoted review and an attribution line. Quotes stay non-heading content so the section keeps a single h2.
useWhen: A page should show social proof from guests or reviewers
avoidWhen: The page needs press coverage logos or award badges instead of guest quotes
